## Who we are
Welcome to **Ducky MC**, a Minecraft server with multiple game modes including Survival, Practice PvP, Skyblock, and a seasonal Survival SMP. Fight other players, build your base, grind resources, or play with friends in an active community. Our SMP runs in different seasons, so every new season starts with a fresh world and new progress for everyone.
